title: Historical Binder: Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria, Vol. II
summary: Cover sheet of the Rotary International historical binder for the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria (Club No. 3334), volume II. It records that the club was organized on 24 April 1930, admitted on 4 June 1930 with 22 charter members, and sponsored by the Mukden club. A stamp states that club membership in R.I. was terminated on 31 December 1940.

title: Table of Contents, 1936-37 and 1937-38
summary: Table of contents of the binder volume for the Rotary years 1936-37 and 1937-38: roster of club membership, club officers, financial matters, sample copies of the club publication, an index-card record of items published in the News Letter up to 30 June 1939, and the credential certificates for the 1937 Nice and 1938 San Francisco conventions.

title: Harbin Rotary Club. Membership List. As at 1-st June, 1936
summary: Printed bilingual (Japanese and English) roster of the Harbin Rotary Club as at 1 June 1936. The first page lists officers and the board of directors for 1935-36 and 1936-37 and the past presidents since 1930; the following pages give each member's name and nickname, classification, business and business address, private address and date of election.

title: Rotary Club of Harbin, 70th Dist. New Officers and Board of Directors 1936-7
summary: Typed list of the officers and board of directors of the Rotary Club of Harbin (70th District) for 1936-37: President Koichi Ehara, Vice-President A. E. Hassek, Secretary Tadao Kawasumi, Treasurer Toshio Maeda, Sergeant at Arms Lui-Tai, Correspondence Secretary Yoshio Gundsi, and eight directors.

title: July 1, 1936, Semi-Annual Report of Club Membership and acknowledgment of remittance due Rotary International
summary: Printed semi-annual report form (original copy) on which the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchoukuo, certifies its membership as of 1 July 1936 and the per capita tax and Rotarian subscriptions due to Rotary International, signed by the president and secretary. Stamped as received in Chicago on 29 July 1936.

title: Letter from the Rotary Club of Harbin to Rotary International on payment of dues at the subnormal rate of exchange, 3 July 1936
summary: The club explains that it owes Rotary International $130.00, equal to ¥261.77 at the normal rate of exchange but costing ¥444.43 on that day, and that it therefore pays ¥261.77 plus half of the difference, in all ¥353.11 or US$103.28. A draft of the Yokohama Specie Bank for that sum is enclosed.

title: January 1, 1937, Semi-Annual Report of Club Membership and acknowledgment of remittance due Rotary International
summary: Semi-annual report form on which the Rotary Club of Harbin certifies its membership as of 1 January 1937 and the amounts due to Rotary International for per capita tax and subscriptions to The Rotarian, signed by president and secretary.

title: Letter from the Rotary Club of Harbin to the Secretary of Rotary International on payment of dues, 14 January 1937
summary: The club states that it owes $132.00 ($130.00 semi-annual subscriptions plus $2.00 for identification cards) and, as in July 1936, pays the yen equivalent at the normal rate of exchange plus half of the difference caused by the subnormal rate, enclosing a Yokohama Specie Bank draft.

title: The Harbin Rotarian, No. 49, October 31st, 1936
summary: Monthly bulletin of the Rotary Club of Harbin with attendance statistics for October 1936 and minutes of the meetings of 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29 October. It reports the farewell to Rotarian Sahara, transferred to Mukden; an address by the architect Y. Endo on architecture in China and Manchuria; the celebration of President Ehara's promotion with a speech by Rotarian Minsky; a talk by Mr. Pedersen on North Manchuria; and a discussion of the poor attendance of Japanese members and of changing the meeting time.

title: The Harbin Rotarian, No. 55, April 30-th, 1937
summary: Bulletin of the Rotary Club of Harbin with attendance statistics for April 1937 and minutes of the meetings of 1, 8, 15 and 24 April. It records the visit of Hsinking Rotarian Lee Shao Ken, the return of members Kaufman and Januszovsky after long absences, a talk on Hangchow and Chekiang province, Kaufman's account of his stay in Shanghai, the Family Night held at the Nichiman Club on 24 April, and remarks by Rotarian Ostroumoff on the growth of Rotary from 4000 to 4200 clubs.

title: Items Published in The NEWS LETTER up to 30 June, 1937
summary: Backing sheet with a pasted index card listing items about the Harbin club published in Rotary International's weekly News Letter between 1930 and 1933: the club's organization by District Governor Yoneyama, its newly elected officers, a message urging conciliation of difficulties in Manchuria, translations of pamphlets into Russian, a publication issued in Russian, Japanese and English, and an appeal for flood relief contributions.

title: Credential Certificate, Rotary International 1937 Convention, Nice, France
summary: Credential certificate (Form B) by which the Rotary Club of Harbin names its delegates and alternates to the 1937 Rotary International convention at Nice. K. Ehara and T. Kawasumi are typed in; a proxy is entered by hand. The club reports 37 members and is entitled to one delegate. The reverse prints the relevant articles of the R.I. constitution and by-laws.

title: Data for 1937-38 Official Directory. Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchoukuo
summary: Duplicate of the club's return for the 1937-38 Official Directory: meetings on Thursdays at 1.00 at the Nichiman Club; president for 1937-38 Kawamura (exchange banking, Yokohama Specie Bank); secretary Yoshio Gundsi (economic investigation, Harbin Railway Directorate); 35 members; club headquarters at the Nichiman Club, 1 Nagorny str., Harbin.

title: July 1, 1937, Semi-Annual Report of Club Membership and acknowledgment of remittance due Rotary International
summary: Semi-annual report form certifying the membership of the Rotary Club of Harbin as of 1 July 1937 and the per capita tax and Rotarian subscriptions due, signed by president and secretary; received in Chicago on 29 July 1937.

title: Letter from the Rotary Club of Harbin to the Secretary of Rotary International on payment of dues, 8 July 1937
summary: The club owes $104.00, equal to ¥209.41 at the normal rate of exchange, and again remits the normal-rate amount plus half of the difference due to the subnormal rate, enclosing a Yokohama Specie Bank draft.

title: January 1, 1938, Semi-Annual Report of Club Membership and acknowledgment of remittance due Rotary International
summary: Semi-annual report form certifying the membership of the Rotary Club of Harbin as of 1 January 1938 and the amounts due to Rotary International, signed by president and secretary.

title: Letter from the Rotary Club of Harbin to the Secretary of Rotary International on payment of dues, January 1938
summary: The club owes $101.00, equal to ¥203.37 at the normal rate of exchange and ¥348.28 on the day; it remits the normal-rate amount plus half of the ¥144.91 difference, with a Yokohama Specie Bank draft enclosed.

title: Semi-Annual Reports record card, Harbin, 1936-1938
summary: Rotary International office ledger card recording, period by period, when semi-annual report forms were mailed to the Harbin club and when reports and remittances were received, with handwritten amounts and date stamps.

title: Address card with mailing slips for the Harbin club secretary, 1936-1938
summary: Record card carrying three pasted address slips showing the club officer to whom Rotary International addressed its mail: Y. Gundsi, Corresponding Secretary, S. M. Rly office (July 1936); Tadao Kawasumi, Secretary, Nippon Commercial Museum (January and July 1937); and Yoshio Gundsi, Secretary, Harbin Railway Directorate (January 1938).

title: Follow-Up Work record card, Harbin, 1936-1938
summary: Rotary International office card headed 'Follow-up work', with period date stamps (July 1936 to January 1938) and otherwise empty columns: no follow-up contacts were recorded for the Harbin club's semi-annual reports.

title: Credential Certificate, Rotary International 1938 Convention, San Francisco, California, U.S.A.
summary: Credential certificate by which the Rotary Club of Harbin designates its delegate to the 1938 Rotary International convention in San Francisco, signed by president and secretary, with the club's membership on 30 April 1938. The reverse prints Article VII of the R.I. constitution on representation and proxies.

title: Semi-Annual Reports record card, Harbin, 1938-1940
summary: Rotary International office ledger card (yellow) continuing the record of semi-annual report forms mailed to and remittances received from the Harbin club, with handwritten amounts and date stamps.

title: Address card with mailing slips for the Harbin club secretary, 1938-1939
summary: Record card with pasted address slips for mail to the Harbin club: Mr. Y. Gundsi, Corresponding Secretary, The Rotary Club, Economic Investigation Bureau, Harbin, Manchuria.

title: Follow-Up Work record card, Harbin, 1938-1940
summary: Rotary International 'Follow-up work' card (yellow) with period date stamps and empty columns.

title: Semi-Annual Reports record card, Harbin, 1940-1941
summary: Rotary International office ledger card (salmon) for semi-annual reports of the Harbin club for the periods of 1940-41.

title: Address card with mailing slip for the Harbin club secretary, 1940
summary: Record card with one pasted address slip: Mr. Yoshio Gundsi, Secretary, The Rotary Club, Nichiman Club, 1 Nagorny pr'ct, Harbin, Manchuria, District 72.

title: Follow-Up Work record card, Harbin, 1940-1941
summary: Rotary International 'Follow-up work' card (salmon), empty apart from the printed headings.

title: Rotary Club Bulletin
summary: Printed green bulletin sheet of the kind Rotary International supplied to clubs, with a blank 'Club News' space. It lists the R.I. committees and their chairmen for 1940-41, reprints a letter of thanks to the Cleveland club from the University Settlement, and carries short filler items, one borrowed from the St. Louis Pepper Box.

title: Charter certificate of the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria, Club No. 3334
summary: Engraved charter certifying that the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria, is a duly elected member of Rotary International as Club No. 3334, dated 4 June 1930 and signed by the president and secretary of Rotary International. It is stamped three times 'CANCELED - This charter is', each stamp signed by the secretary, Chesley R. Perry.
